moveRight.description: Make the selected section a child of the previous section

moveWithChildren.description: Move the selected section with its children into the previous section

moveLeft.description: Lift the selected section to the level of its parent

merge.description: Merge the selected section with the following section

view.description: Show the selected element in the Body view

viewSource.description: Show the selected element in the Source view

moveUp.description: Swap the selected section with the section before it

moveDown.description: Swap the selected section with the section after it
